commands.author: Papilionidae

target.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Skills are copied into the sandbox workspace on every sandbox setup. For users who do not use skills or have already deployed them through other means, this sync is unnecessary overhead that slows down sandbox initialization and consumes disk space.

Related: #97638

## Why This Change Was Made

The issue requests a config toggle to skip the skills sync step. This change adds skipSkillsSync as an optional boolean under agents.defaults.sandbox and agents.list[].sandbox, defaulting to false (preserving existing behavior).

Key design decision: skipSkillsSync only suppresses file copying (syncSkillsToWorkspace), NOT skill eligibility computation. Remote skill eligibility is still computed even when the flag is true, so Agent prompts continue to advertise available skills correctly. The user just needs to ensure preinstalled skills are already present in the sandbox workspace via other means (custom Docker image, setupCommand, or readonly workspace).

## User Impact

Users can now opt out of skill sync with:

```json5
{
  agents: {
    defaults: {
      sandbox: {
        skipSkillsSync: true,
      },
    },
  },
}
```

Safe-use caveat: This flag is intended for advanced deployments where skills are preinstalled in the sandbox workspace through other means (custom Docker image, setupCommand, readonly workspace mounts). When enabled, file copying is skipped but skill eligibility is still advertised in prompts. If you use this flag without preinstalled skills, skill-related prompts will show eligible skills that do not exist in the workspace.

## Evidence

### Architecture change

The previous implementation hid the entire syncSandboxSkillsToWorkspace call behind if (!cfg.skipSkillsSync). That helper both copies files AND computes skill eligibility. The fix extracts eligibility computation into a separate computeSandboxSkillsEligibility() helper that runs regardless of the flag.

### Test evidence (3 test states)

Before (existing test, unchanged): requests-skill-sync-for-read-only-sandbox-workspaces syncSkillsToWorkspace IS called when skipSkillsSync is absent (false by default). skillsEligibility is returned.

After (new test 1): skips-skill-sync-when-skipSkillsSync-is-enabled-with-read-only-workspace syncSkillsToWorkspaceMock is NOT called when workspaceAccess=ro and skipSkillsSync=true. skillsEligibility IS still returned.

After (new test 2): skips-skill-sync-when-skipSkillsSync-is-enabled-with-writable-workspace syncSkillsToWorkspaceMock is NOT called when workspaceAccess=rw and skipSkillsSync=true. skillsEligibility IS still returned.

### Diff summary

7 files, +99/-20:
src/config/types.agents-shared.ts (+1) type definition
src/config/zod-schema.agent-runtime.ts (+1) Zod schema
src/agents/sandbox/types.ts (+1) resolved runtime type (optional)
src/agents/sandbox/config.ts (+1) config resolver
src/agents/sandbox/context.ts (+33/-18) extracted computeSandboxSkillsEligibility, guard only file copy
src/agents/sandbox.resolveSandboxContext.test.ts (+62) 2 new test cases
